description: Golden regression pages: real pages from the CBIT R22, CBIT R22A and AICTE documents whose expected structure was read by hand from the PDF text. Used twice: (1) the pipeline's evaluation step measures per-page topic recall/precision against expected_topics; (2) backend/tests/test_golden_regression.py re-parses frozen snapshots of these pages and asserts the invariants, so a parser change that breaks known-good pages fails the test suite.
caveat: Expectations were written by the assistant from the page text, not by a curriculum expert. They are a regression baseline for known-good pages, not ground truth for the whole corpus. expected_topics lists a representative subset of each page's topics, so 'precision' here only counts extracted topics that match one of the listed items and is a lower bound.

must_not_be_topics: Understand the basics of Operating systems and its major components

pages.prerequisite_contains: Basic knowledge of programming language such as python
must_not_be_topics: Analyse various linear and nonlinear data structures

expected_topics: Defining structures and Array of Structures
must_not_be_topics: Schaum's Outline of Programming with C

expected_topics: Version control tools - GIT and GitHub
pages.regression_note: Table-column page: the Topics table sits BELOW the AU-101 header. Before the reading-order fix these topics were attributed to the previous course (HSMC-102).
